review.use_summary: Used MVP Release 4 genotypes whose data core pre-phased and imputed against TOPMed with SHAPEIT4 v4.1.3 and Minimac4 before the study-specific ancestry and GWAS/TWAS quality control.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is a supplied upstream data-processing stage. TOPMed data access, Minimac imputation, ancestry assignment and GReX estimation are separate; do not infer that the study authors reran the MVP core phasing.

review.use_summary: Phased genomes with the reported ShapeIT v2.12 at default parameters, using the low-coverage 1000 Genomes reference panel and phase-informative reads. Linked reads were used to estimate switch error rates and select a phasing strategy.
review.implementation_scope_note: Retain the literal reported v2.12: the legacy distribution separately labels r-builds and GLIBC2.12, so this text does not uniquely identify a runtime. Read-aware phasing and reference-panel integration cannot be substituted with ordinary SHAPEIT4/5 cohort phasing. Supplementary Note 2 supplies further strategy details; its full protocol remains to be reviewed. Legacy SHAPEIT2 has separate restricted academic terms.

review.use_summary: Described UKBB genotypes produced by a two-step SHAPEIT pre-phasing and IMPUTE2 imputation process using HRC and UK10K haplotype resources, followed by the stated cohort and variant quality control.
review.implementation_scope_note: The SHAPEIT generation and patch are not reported. The paragraph also calls the post-imputation metric Minimac r2 and states a MAC>100 removal; retain these source attributions without inventing a Minimac execution or repairing the inequality. Phasing, untyped-variant imputation and post-imputation QC are separate.

review.use_summary: Reported QMDiab Omni2.5 array processing with SHAPEIT and 1000 Genomes phase3 haplotypes, described in the paper as imputation. Genotypes were available for 325 samples with proteomics data.
review.implementation_scope_note: The SHAPEIT generation, patch and exact phasing/imputation commands are not stated. Do not assign the separately described Tarkin Minimac3 or PLINK/bcftools settings to the QMDiab SHAPEIT stage, or invent another QMDiab imputation program.

review.use_summary: Estimated haplotypes for Japanese datasets using SHAPEIT4 before Minimac4 genotype imputation; the imputation reference comprised 11,754 Japanese whole-genome-sequenced individuals.
review.implementation_scope_note: The reference panel is specified for imputation, but the text does not uniquely specify SHAPEIT4 patch or whether that panel was supplied to SHAPEIT4 itself. Do not infer reference-mode command flags or imputation equivalence from the phaser name.

review.use_summary: Phased the BBJ first cohort with SHAPEIT2, reported as v.2.837, before Minimac4 imputation. The separately supplied ToMMo dataset used SHAPEIT2 v2.R837 before IMPUTE2 imputation.
review.implementation_scope_note: Preserve both literal version strings and cohort assignments. BBJ second-cohort and NCGG phasing used EAGLE2, not SHAPEIT2; the imputation programs and downstream QC are separate. Legacy exact-build and license eligibility remain necessary for an original SHAPEIT2 execution.

review.use_summary: Phased quality-controlled US Intermountain chip genotypes using SHAPEIT4; long-range phased chip samples and in-house methods were then used to prepare the sequence-variant haplotype reference panel.
review.implementation_scope_note: The SHAPEIT4 patch is not stated. WGS calling with Graphtyper, the in-house long-range phasing/reference construction and later imputation are distinct stages; a standard SHAPEIT4 run does not reproduce that complete reference-building pipeline.

review.use_summary: Used SHAPEIT5 with 1000 Genomes phase3 haplotypes for MSMC demographic analyses. Separately used phase_common_static with that reference before CHROMOPAINTER, and common-marker phasing of Armenian genomes before the IMPUTE5 imputation benchmark.
review.implementation_scope_note: The patch and full parameter sets are not reported. The paper writes phasing_common in its imputation section; retain that wording as a source label while distinguishing the actual upstream phase_common program. CHROMOPAINTER, MSMC and IMPUTE5 analyses, masking and reference augmentation remain separate.

supporting_evidence.section: Material and methods / Population genomic analyses

review.use_summary: Filled missing genotypes with SHAPEIT5 in cohort-only mode, without an external reference, after constructing the 229,986-SNP harmonized ancestry-prediction input set.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is missing-call imputation within the retained SNP set, not evidence of reference-panel imputation of additional untyped variants. PLINK SNP intersection, MAF/missingness filters, LD pruning, HLA exclusion and neural-network ancestry prediction are separate.

review.use_summary: Used a Snakemake SHAPEIT5 wrapper for chromosome chunks in G&H, BBJ and BioMe, combining exome and array genotypes with exome variants prioritized at overlaps. Common variants, described as MAF>0.001, formed the scaffold for rare-variant phasing; the UKB expansion used a similar two-stage procedure. Downstream compound-heterozygote analyses retained PP>0.90.
review.implementation_scope_note: The patch, chunk/ligation details and exact parameter files are not given in these paragraphs. Preserve the paper's strict MAF wording without assuming that a current --filter-maf 0.001 implementation has the same equality boundary. 100kGP reused external phased data; AOU was not phased and used homozygous burdens only. Posterior filtering, recessive burden construction and association analysis are separate.
